Become a Lion

Make a difference right here at home.

Our community is stronger when neighbors come together. Join the Skowhegan Lions Club and help make a positive difference in the lives of others.

Ask About Membership
More Than Membership

There's a place for you in our club.

Lions are people who care about their communities and are willing to lend a helping hand. We bring together people from different backgrounds who share a common desire to serve others.

Whether you have a little time to give or want to become more involved, your ideas, experience, and enthusiasm can make a difference.

Why Become a Lion?

Good things happen when we serve together.

Being part of the Skowhegan Lions Club is an opportunity to help others while building friendships and connections.

♡

Help Your Community

Support local residents, assist families, and take part in projects that make a meaningful difference in the Skowhegan area.

✦

Build Friendships

Meet people who share your interest in helping others and develop lasting friendships through service.

◎

Make an Impact

Take part in vision assistance, scholarships, community activities, and other worthwhile efforts.

☆

Grow as a Volunteer

Share your talents, learn new skills, develop leadership experience, and discover new ways to serve.

Grow as a Leader

Discover your leadership potential.

Lions membership offers more than the opportunity to serve. It can also open doors to personal growth, leadership development, and opportunities to make an impact on a much larger scale.

Members can develop their skills, take on new responsibilities, and grow into leadership positions within the club, across their district, and throughout Lions Clubs International.

01

Club Leadership

Begin by serving your local club. Members can take on committee responsibilities and eventually serve as club officers, including secretary, treasurer, or club president.

02

Zone Leadership

Expand your involvement by working with multiple clubs in your area. Zone leadership offers the opportunity to support club success, encourage collaboration, and help develop other Lions.

03

District Leadership

Take on a broader leadership role by serving at the district level. Experienced Lions can pursue positions such as district governor, helping guide clubs and advance service throughout their district.

04

Leadership Beyond the District

For those who want to go further, Lions offers opportunities for leadership at the multiple-district, national, and international levels. Your leadership journey can reach far beyond your hometown.

Leadership begins with a willingness to serve.

You don't need to be an experienced leader to become a Lion. Lions provides opportunities to learn, grow, and develop along the way.

Getting Started

How to become a Skowhegan Lion.

Getting involved is easy. Start by reaching out and getting to know our club.

01

Get in Touch

Contact us and let us know you're interested in learning more about the Skowhegan Lions Club.

02

Meet Our Members

Come meet our members, ask questions, and learn about our activities. You're welcome to get a feel for the club before deciding to join.

03

Become Involved

Explore membership with the club and discover how you can contribute your time and talents to our community.
